home.eyebrowless_headline: Your subject, your board, your language.

home.demoNoticeBody: Lessons and quizzes shown here are original demonstration content. Always verify against your official syllabus and textbook.

home.languageHeading: Switch languages without losing your place

home.safetyBody: No public profiles, no student chat, no ads, no behavioural tracking. Every AI reply can be reported in one tap.
